content: Obo kwa Samwẹl
Samwẹl e ope, anọng p'Israẹl biphyir atzọbha, abẹ abhom-ẹ. Bẹ atza anọhng-ẹ ka Rama kw'ode obhon kwẹ. Devid, ọmaana Abigẹl Mẹ wọ, Devid obina ochina k'ibe s'anọng anarukhi sa Paran.

Wa ọkhaam ojinọng wani ka Maọn kw'ọkhaam ẹkhakhaama ka Kaamẹl, kẹ wa ode ọkkọkka kw'ideden. Kẹ wa ọkhaam avugbokha nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh, obiro ọkhaama arukhimaan nnọhna nzenamfa obhiri arọbh jobh p'iwa om-ophyiri ophyubha ka Kaamẹl.
Ojinọng nwa wa okpen Nabal, kwanọng kwẹ okpena Abigẹl. Wa Kwanọng nwa ọkhaam eronga, obiro ojibh kwanọng, yina, odim kwẹ ode oKalẹb-nọng kw'ọkhaam ẹmmaana ch'ikkamgbagbara, obiro osi ẹrama.
Mada Devid owobh k'ibe s'anọng anarukhi ọbhaanga bi, Nabal om-ophyiri arukhimaan pẹ ophyubha,
Wa Devid okwu ọtzọhm adikkobh jobh oben bẹ bi, “Bọng nọhng ka Kaamẹl atza arima Nabal anang-m.
Bọng ben-ẹ bi, ‘Kọ ruk akpen p'adumi eden! Ofor-gaangi owobha ttar-ọ ọmaana ẹhọhmmọr chọ, ttara ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'ode fọ.

“ ‘Mmaang bi, ogbe wọ ma kw'arukhimaan ophyubha ophyi-phyiri. Mada iwa akkeri-arukhimaan pọ awobh ttara man, wa man bẹ itzama kosi. Ogbe kw'iwa bẹ awobh ka Kaamẹl biphyir, ọttọhk manda vani fabẹ f'odimi kode.

Kọ bọbh atzọhmnọng pọ, bẹ ágbaakh-ọ ọgbaak. Mẹ wọ, kọ si ọphyaam anang adikkobh paam, da mokwu k'ẹdadaami-wu. Tzotzokhaan kọ nang atzọhmnọng pọ, ọmaana kaam nnwa kwọ Devid kpenamkpen f'akhaam bi anang bẹ.’ ”
Mada ajinọng pa Devid apyiri, bẹ atzọkha ẹkkaabha cha Devid agbaak Nabal. Bẹ an-awobha atzik.
Nabal obhina atzọhmnọng pa Devid bi, “Anyi wọ ode Devid ode? Anyi wọ ode nnwa nwa kwa Jẹsẹ ode? Iwu nna atzọhmnọng haabhada an-am-abhaangi ka mbọhk sa abitta pabẹ.
Okhuri yan kw'ira kaam nna ndọkha brẹd kwaam, ọmaana asi, ttara etzen cha kaam mfhu bi, nnang anọng paam p'am-aphyiri arukhimaan-phyubha, ndọkha nnang anọng p'ọnọng oni orong ibe sa bẹ afona akwu o?”
Ajinọng pa Devid abhakhi nnam abhana. Mada bẹ apyiri, bẹ agbaak Devid odem kwa kwẹ ode biphyir.

Devid oben ajinọng pẹ bi, “Bọng dabh akkangkkaang pabọng!” Mẹ wọ, bẹ adabh akkangkkaang pabẹ, Devid obiro ọdabh kwẹ. Wa anọng ẹnọhna bọ atzọni Devid abẹ, yina, ọtzọkha anọng arọbh jobh ohok bi, bẹ akkeri egbongkpo.

Ọtzọhmnọng wani kwa Nabal ọgbaak Abigẹl kw'ode kwanọng kwa Nabal bi, “Devid ọtzọhmi akkaabh-nkkaabha p'afon k'ibe s'anọng anarukhi bi, bẹ akwu arima itta kwaman e, yina, kẹ on-otzer ọnang bẹ mgbarsa-dik.
K'odik ọkka, wa anọng mba ajibhi idik atzima atzor man. Wa bẹ man itzama kàsi, ogbe nwa biphyir kwa mowobh k'iwoni ọbaanga bẹ, ọttọhk manda vani faman kobiro odimi.
Bẹ akkeri man k'ẹya, akkeri man k'erungi k'ogbe nwa kw'am-om-okkeri arukhimaan paman biphyir, ọbaanga bẹ.

Kọ si ochibhi atzena mẹ, are odem kw'asi, okhuri bi, itzama in-ibe ma s'itto ikhebha itta kwaman ọmaana ẹhọhmmọr chẹ biphyir. Kẹ ọkhaam ikkaam-gbagbara ọyọhnga ọbọhk, itzọhng k'om-oyonga ọnang ọnọng manda wani.”

Abigẹl ogbe kokhibhi, ọtzọkha brẹd arọbh jobh, ọmaana atzuk-gbere afa, ọmaana arukhimaan azen p'ọkk-ọbhaabha, ọmaana agbangbang-dim azen p'abọkpa-bhaabha, ọmaana agwọk arọbh azen p'agrep p'agwu-ogwu, ttara agwọk arọbh jobh p'afig p'agwu-ogwu ọnana nnyanyaang.
Mẹ wọ, on-oben atzọhmnọng pẹ bi, “Bọng chi-m eden arọhng; kaam ńdor bọng nnam nkwuma e.” Yina, wa odim kwẹ Nabal kọgbaakhi.
Mada ọm-ọyaar ẹnyanyaang chẹ ọwọna egbegbeho, ore da Devid ọmaana ajinọng pẹ am-abira ahakha atzor-ẹ ka for, bẹ atza attema ayok abẹ.

Devid okk'ọtzam obena bi, “K'odik ọkka, kwẹ ode ndidimi ọnang bi, nkkeri ẹkhakhaama ch'ayi nwa k'ibe s'anọng anarukhi, ifha ọttọhk manda vani fẹ oningi odimi. Ma, kẹ okk'itzama on-otzima ochora ejibha chaam e.
Tte Ibinọkpaabyi osi attattaanga-nọng pa Devid mach'ọdaakh-ẹ, idikha ntte ojinọng manda wani kwẹ ọbọhk oruk akpen ophyini k'ekpebha.”
Mada Abigẹl ore Devid, ọhakha k'ẹnyanyaang chẹ m'ẹbhar k'ẹbhar, ọrakha ottima itzitzikha k'irerek m'itzitzikha sa Devid.

Ọttẹ-ẹ ma mmo oben bi, “Itta kwaam, tte oponga-pyibha ode kwaam manchen e. Tzotzokhaan, tte kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ mgbaak atzim nnang-ọ, yong-m itzọhng abhaanga odik kwa kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ ngaam bi, mgbaakh-ọ.

Tte itta kwaam oningi ẹmmaana-tzama ch'ojinọng nwuma kwa bẹ ayeri Nabal ọsaan e. Kẹ osi edidingi otzor ka che chẹ, che chẹ eyini odidingi-nọng, mando kw'orukhi akpen ochina. Yina, kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ, ajinọng p'itta kwaam ọtzọhmi kinne e.

“Mada Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọsa bi, kọ itta kwaam aningi oponga-phyibha kw'ẹnọngmon atzọk, ọmaana bi, kọ aningi odik ka for sọ abira atzukha. Da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi orukhi akpen, kọ abira aruk akpen, tte attattaanga-nọng pọ ọmaana anọng biphyir p'achibhi itzama ọmaana itta kwaam, atzọkha ettuma macha Nabal.
Mẹ wọ, tte itta kwaam okhera bi, ọtzọkha ẹnanga nda cha kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ nkk'ndimi nkwu, ọnang ajinọng p'am-atzọn-ẹ abẹ.

Tzotzokhaan, bina nang ottotto kwa kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi óttima ẹhọhmmọr ch'itta kwaam aranga bi gbuk, okhuri da kẹ om-orima mgbong s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Itzama s'íkhọbh-ọ itzor k'odem kw'arukhi akpen kide.

Kaambi ode bi, ọnọng okhubh-ọ bi ọfhọ-ọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwọ, wọ ókkeri akpen p'itta kwaam, mach'ọnọng okkeri ọttọhk f'ohokhi ettem. Yina, kẹ odimi akpen p'attattanga-nọng pọ mach'ọtza kwa bẹ abhari k'ibhar-atza.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ósi odik-jibhada kpenamkpen kw'ochekhi ọ́nang itta kwaam, obiro ótzekh-ẹ mach'ọdabhi kw'Israẹl.
For sọ kápyima k'ẹnọngmon, for sọ kabira ápyima bi arengmmo atzukha odik. K'ogbe kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwọ, okk'itta kwaam ọda, jima kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ o.”
Devid oben Abigẹl bi, “Ẹtzọhnga ẹkhaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl, kw'ọkk'ọ ọtzọhma k'ewu cha mayina ochen-m.
Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọdọ-ọ k'eronga chọ, da obiro otzim-ọ akkaan-m nnaanga ẹnọngmon k'ewu cha mayina, mbọhk saam kimbiri ndima ndukha odik.

Oni mando ode, k'odik ọkka, mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl orukhi akpen, kw'obiro ọkpa-m bi nning-ọ itzama nsi, idikha ira ani ẹbhar-ẹbhar akwu bi more ayok, ojinọng manda wani kw'ode kwa Nabal kw'oruk akpen yina ewu ehobha kode.”
Mẹ wọ, Devid ọn-ọtzọkha ekpo py'Abigẹl otzim ochen-ẹ, oben-ẹ bi, “Rọhng abhana k'odidiri. Kaam nkk'atzim pọ mmaanga, ńsi-osi mach'abeni.”
Mada Abigẹl ọbhan, otza okhebha Nabal k'ọhọhm da om-osi ọdadaami mach'ọvaarnọng, Nabal okk'ọgwa obuma da ettem ẹdaam-ẹ. Mẹ wọ, kwanọng kẹ odik kọgbaakhi maa ewu ehobha.
Mada ewu en-ehobh, da atzuk akk'Nabal attoni, kwanọng kwẹ ọtzọkha idik nna biphyir ọgbaakh-ẹ, okhubhachi ọbọkh-ẹ, on-oyima mach'ọtza.
Ọttọhk k'iwu jobh k'itzitzikha, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obun Nabal ofhu, Nabal e, ope.

Mada Devid ọbhaang bi, Nabal ọkk'ọpa, oben bi, “Ẹtzọhnga ewobha ẹnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'okk'Nabal abẹ orima ọnang-m okhuri da om-osi idik s'olukh-m. Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ọtzọhmnọng kwẹ eden ọkpa bi, oningi itzama osi, on-obiro osi itzama sa Nabal ikpa nnam itzor kẹ ọkhaam.” Mẹ wọ, Devid ọn-ọtzọhm ẹkkaabha bi, bẹ atza abọbh Abigẹl eyonga bi ode kwanọng kwẹ.
Atzọhmnọng pẹ achina ka Kaamẹl atza aben Abigẹl bi, “Devid okk'man ọtzọhma bi, mokwu ọtzọkh-ọ, atza ade kwanọng kwẹ e.”
Abigẹl ochunga ottima itzitzikha k'irerek, oben bi, “Kkeri kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ ma e, kaam nkk'for nda bi nsi ọtzọhm nnang-ọ e, bi mbiri mgbobhi mmo s'atzọhmnọng p'itta kwaam e.”
Abigẹl ogbe kokhibhi obina ovura ẹnyanyaang, otzima aminava azen p'ade atzọhmnọng pẹ, ọtzọn atzọhmnọng pa Devid abẹ, ọtza ọba Devid.
Wa Devid okk'Ahinoam kw'ofon Jẹzrẹl ọtzam ọtzọkha, bẹ anọng afa an-ade panọng pẹ.
Yina, wa Saul okk'nnwa kwẹ Mikal kw'ode kwanọng kwa Devid, ọtzọkha ọnang Palti kw'ode nnwa kwa Laish kw'iwa ofon Galim, k'ọbada.
